sources.entry: Recall - Local-first clipboard manager with on-device semantic search, two-factor codes, and credentials that delete themselves.

summary.one_liner: Recall is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar clipboard manager with on-device semantic search, built-in TOTP/HOTP two-factor codes, and automatic detection and deletion of secrets copied to the clipboard.
summary.what_it_does: Recall records everything copied to the clipboard and lets you search by meaning using an on-device embedding model plus a query expander, with operators like kind:, app:, since: and is:pinned. Clips that match one of 29 credential rules are marked secret, kept in memory only, hidden from AI features, and deleted 60 seconds later by default. Clips from 28 password managers and authenticators are dropped before they are read. The app generates TOTP and HOTP codes through a separate sandboxed XPC helper process that never returns seed values, with Touch ID gating by default. It also offers "Paste as…" transforms via an on-device model, snippets with shortcodes that expand via an event tap, a todo list, and OCR of screen regions and copied images. The README says no data leaves the Mac except optional link title and favicon fetching.
use_cases: store and filter copied snippets and links
keep passwords and API keys out of clipboard history
expand text shortcodes like signatures or addresses
extract text from screenshots with OCR
notable: Secret detection with 29 capture-time rules, and it shows which rule fired; secrets are deleted 60 seconds after capture by default
Two-factor seeds live in a separate sandboxed XPC helper that exposes no call returning a secret
In-Memory Mode runs entirely in RAM with no database file
Operator-based search and Smart Collections saved as rules
Paste as… runs an on-device transform with a preview before pasting
caveats: No prebuilt download; builds are ad-hoc signed, so Gatekeeper refuses them and you must build from source with macOS 26 or later
Accessibility permission is lost on each update until Developer ID signing ships
Shortcodes cannot expand in password fields because macOS Secure Event Input blocks the event tap
No Persian OCR because macOS Vision has no Persian recogniser
